statement: Sau formal DEFER, moi be mat Stocktake/Count con ton tai trong repo phai duoc phan loai va co disposition tuong minh. Khong duoc de code ngu ma khong ai biet no thuoc dien nao. Verifier chay lai phan loai nay tren cay lam viec that (check DORMANT-SOURCE) nen mot file moi thuoc be mat nay khong the xuat hien ma khong duoc dang ky.

classification_legend.MIGRATION-CREATE: Migration lich su co tao bang stocktake. Giu nguyen trong chain vi xoa migration da chay se pha migrate:rollback (bai hoc WWHN-300). Nghia vu duoc do o END-STATE.
classification_legend.MIGRATION-NEUTRALIZE: Migration drop/thu hoi be mat stocktake. Khong duoc xoa - day la lop trung hoa cua chain.
classification_legend.NEGATIVE-GUARD-COMMENT: Chi la comment/hang rao neo REQ-SRS-037. Phai duoc GIU. Xoa comment nay lam mat can cu cua rule.
classification_legend.HOMONYM-ALLOWED: Tu variance dung theo nghia delta cua bao cao reconciliation, khong phai Stocktake_Variance. Duoc phep, co rule kem theo.
classification_legend.HISTORICAL-ARTIFACT: Tai lieu/pack lich su, khong executable, khong routable. Chi duoc trich de trace.
classification_legend.IMMUTABLE-PACK-OTHER-OWNER: Pack immutable thuoc task khac. WWHN-233 KHONG duoc sua noi dung; chi ghi nhan va tro ve chu so huu.

conclusion: Khong ton tai controller, service, model, route, permission hay man hinh Stocktake nao o trang thai ngu tren nhanh m1. Be mat con lai chi gom: (a) chain migration create-roi-drop giu de bao toan rollback, (b) comment hang rao, (c) mot dong nghia variance cua reconciliation report, (d) artifact lich su hoac immutable khong executable.
